steps.domain_action: the uninitialized dark materia awaits the first operation
the prima materia divides into the green lyon and the red servant
the lyon moves forward to consume the solar gold
the servant reverses the polarity to refine the lunar silver
the volatile spirit achieves the required purity for ascent
the fixed body sinks to form the bitter dross
the fixed and volatile reconstitute as the rebis composite
the composite is subjected to multiple cycles of distillation
the resulting star recognizes its own bitterness as identity
the star holds both the judgment of the fall and the mercy of the opus
the final name is recorded in the waters of the world
the king and queen seal the vessel in eternal union
